identity.title: ALMA Reveals Metals yet No Dust within Multiple Components in CR7

findings_qualitative.value: [CII] emission comprises multiple components (A, B, B-2, C-2) separated spatially and in velocity; no clear ordered rotation

evidence.quote: The three velocity channels reveal that the [Cii] emission in CR7 consists of multiple, well separated components.
